FN-TUUN59-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 159
Committee: Ways and Means General Fund Sponsor: Representative David Faulkner
Analyst: Riley Aaron Date: 03/27/2023
House Bill 159 as introduced could increase the obligations of the State General Fund by an
undetermined amount dependent upon the amount of attorney fees paid in relation to certain
petitions consulted on and prepared for a petitioner by an attorney prior to official appointment,
as approved by the probate judge.
